title: [WT-19] Integration and hardening: flip worktreeMode on, close parity, sweep file-only edges
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §7 (migration) and §8 (file-only dependency sweep). This is the epic's ONE integration-and-hardening task. The epic touched shared types (types/schema.ts: worktreeMode, workspaceMode, landingRetry), the MCP wire (claim/get_context workspace, finalize_attempt unlanded) and both wrappers, so full regression runs here.

Objective: turn worktree mode on by default only after the whole flow is proven end to end, and close the gaps no single slice could see.

Deliverable:
1. Flip the default in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts: `resolveWorktreeMode` returns 'on' when settings.worktreeMode is unset. Add vitest cases in validators.test.ts for unset→on, 'off'→off and 'on'→on. Change docs/CONFIGURATION.md's default to on, with the §7.4 rollback note ('off' restores shared mode).
2. Add the MOE_WORKTREE_, MOE_LAND_, MOE_CONTROL_ and MOE_BOARD_ families to the compared families in scripts/tests/parity-check.sh and parity-check.ps1.
3. File-only dependency sweep with moe.set_task_dependencies. Start from the governor audit list in §8: V07←01f37ac6, V04c←V08b, RF04←90664db1, RF07←465ee875, RF07←80930ce6, R13←R11e, R13←2cf1c6be, 724e31fa←e7f4026a, 01f37ac6←e7f4026a. For every still-open task's edge A←B, apply the §8 re-derivation rule: keep it if A names anything B produces; drop it only when the sole overlap is a shared existing file. The completion summary lists each edge as kept or dropped, with a reason.
4. Full regression (record pass counts):
   - npm test in packages/moe-daemon, packages/moe-proxy and packages/moe-claude-plugin;
   - bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh and pwsh scripts/tests/postflight.ps1;
   - the worktree-landing.{sh,ps1} suites from WT-08T;
   - parity-check.{sh,ps1};
   - cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test, run under a jetbrains-gradle lease (moe.acquire_resource);
   - npm run lint.
5. End-to-end check in a throwaway repo made by `git init` under mktemp, with worktreeMode on. Two tasks in parallel touch disjoint files and both land on main. A third conflicts, goes to unlanded, then lands after the resume. Assert main's history is linear with no force-push (reflog shows only fast-forward updates).
6. Whole-epic adversarial pass (adversarial-self-review) over `git diff <epic base>..main` against the doc's §2-§6 contracts: drift between producer and consumer (daemon field names vs wrapper reads), sh/ps1 twin drift, codes documented in WT-17 but never emitted. Fix findings inside these files, or file them as bug: tasks in this epic.
7. Post the flip runbook (TROUBLESHOOTING section from WT-16) to #general for the human. Say that this project's worker seats stop with MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING until the control checkout is switched to moe/control.

NOT in scope: new features; re-editing docs other than CONFIGURATION.md (findings there become bug: tasks); changing shared-mode behavior.

Verification: cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/state/validators.test.ts && npm test && cd ../.. && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && npm run lint
definitionOfDone: resolveWorktreeMode defaults to 'on' (validators.test.ts covers unset/on/off) and docs/CONFIGURATION.md states default on plus the 'off' rollback.
parity-check.sh and parity-check.ps1 compare the MOE_WORKTREE_, MOE_LAND_, MOE_CONTROL_ and MOE_BOARD_ families, and both exit 0.
Every audited dependsOn edge, and every open edge re-derived by the §8 rule, is kept or dropped via moe.set_task_dependencies, with the list and reasons in the completion summary.
Full regression is green with recorded counts: daemon/proxy/claude-plugin npm test, postflight.{sh,ps1}, worktree-landing.{sh,ps1}, ./gradlew test (under the jetbrains-gradle lease) and npm run lint.
The throwaway-repo end-to-end run lands two parallel tasks plus one conflict-resumed task on main with fast-forward-only history.
The whole-epic adversarial findings are fixed or filed as bug: tasks, and the flip runbook is posted to #general naming MOE_CONTROL_NOT_FOLLOWING.
taskRails: DoD readings for QA. DoD 3: the completion summary classifies every candidate edge as 'moot' (an end is DONE/ARCHIVED), 'kept (produces)' naming what B produces, or 'drop-after-runbook' (the only overlap is a shared existing file). Kept and moot edges need no moe.set_task_dependencies call. A drop-after-runbook edge counts as handled when the summary lists it with its reason and the step-5 #general post hands it to governors. A governor removes it only once this project runs in worktree mode, which is after this row's QA, so QA must not require those removals. DoD 1: 'defaults to on' means the (b) the human approved, in decision dec-eb7b8337 or a row comment of theirs. With the recommended (b), unset resolves to 'on' only with a non-blank qualityGate, else 'off'.

(c) WT-S comment-54c4e7a6 item 2:
- The remote race: A publishes while B's fetch and push fail. There must be no fork (local == origin), and B ends unlanded 'remote'.
- An unknown push outcome that receipt_replay later resolves.

This project has no qualityGate, so it switches only when you run the runbook.
Approve = go on (a)+(b). To choose another (b), reject and comment on the task."
